reply.text:
Being scared of carbs is worth talking through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, because cutting out a whole food group out of fear is a pattern better handled with them than with a coach. I'm not going to build workouts around eating no carbs, and I'd rather not hand you tips for training on less fuel.

I'm glad to help with the training itself once you've had that conversation. In the meantime, if you want to tell me what you've been doing lately, I can look at your recent sessions with you.
